findings.evidence: <select id="dob-day-select" autocomplete="bday-day" required=""> <select id="dob-month-select" autocomplete="bday-month" required=""> <select id="dob-year-select" autocomplete="bday-year" required="">
findings.fix: Use three short text fields for day, month and year, with the numeric input mode.
findings.violation: A date the person knows by heart is picked from three drop-downs, the year from 60 options.

findings.evidence: #name-input (Full name) and #legalname-input (Your name) both collect the person's name
findings.fix: Remove the duplicate 'Your name' field, or clarify that 'Legal name' serves a distinct purpose from 'Full name'.
findings.violation: This field asks for the person's name a second time after 'Full name' was already collected, duplicating effort.

findings.evidence: <input id="postal-input" name="postal_code" type="text" autocomplete="postal-code" required="" size="3"> (size=3)
findings.fix: Size the field to show at least 5 characters.
findings.violation: This postal code field shows 3 characters, too few to show a typical value whole while it is typed and checked.

findings.fix: Loosen the pattern to accept every valid way of writing the value, and normalise it after submission.
findings.violation: The pattern on this phone field rejects valid values such as +44 20 7946 0958; 020 7946 0958.

findings.evidence: #viewdetails-btn appears before the final fieldset (Date of birth), interrupting field completion
findings.fix: Move the View details button to after all fields are complete, or make it a secondary action visibly less prominent than the submit button.
findings.violation: A secondary action sits above the form's final fields, disrupting the field-completion flow and suggesting the form ends before all fields are shown.

findings.evidence: #contacttime-input collects 'Preferred contact time', which is not a standard account-creation requirement
findings.fix: Move this field to a later step, or clarify why the account-creation task needs it now.
findings.violation: This field's answer does not serve the account-creation task and could wait for a later step.

findings.evidence: font-size: 13px declared by its inline style
findings.fix: Set the field's font size to at least 16 pixels.
findings.violation: The text in this field is 13 pixels, below the 16 pixels at which a phone stops zooming the page on focus.
This web address field is type text, so a phone does not show the keyboard built for it.

findings.evidence: #contacttime-label has style="display:inline-block;float:left;width:140px", placing it beside its field while other labels sit above
findings.fix: Remove the inline style from the label to align it with the rest of the form, or set every label to the same position.
findings.violation: This form mixes label positions: most labels sit above their fields, but this label sits beside its field, breaking visual consistency.
